provenance: Unmodified camera EXIF/MakerNote regression captures from libexif b2edc5a8adf4d1b79ce9413a9c9d8f3ab871c082. Expected Make/Model values come from independent upstream .parsed reports. Metadata-only captures do not establish pixel or capture authenticity. LGPL-2.1-or-later; see licenses/libexif-COPYING.txt. Existing corpora cover real encoded TagLib media and QPDF documents; synthetic fixtures remain separately labelled. Two unmodified AndroidX LGE Nexus 5 and Samsung SM-N900S smartphone JPEGs at 7fd498e00ec996faa46082757c2e3db0b537bdc6 use independent ExpectedAttributes.java expectations (blob b21fa45df136cccbea0965ba3aed4752bc6c4c3b); Apache-2.0, Copyright The Android Open Source Project.
